/endpoints/*/assessment/certificate_vali: Combines trusted_chain and hostname_valid with whether the scan time falls inside the certificate's validity window.
/endpoints/*/assessment/expired: Checks whether the scan time is later than the certificate's not_after.
/endpoints/*/assessment/expiring_soon: Checks that the certificate has not expired and that expires_in_days is 30 or less.
/endpoints/*/assessment/hostname_valid: Copies certificate.hostname_valid, and writes false when the endpoint presents no certificate.
/endpoints/*/assessment/legacy_protocol_: Checks whether protocol_support.tls_1_0 or protocol_support.tls_1_1 is true.
/endpoints/*/assessment/modern_protocol: Checks whether protocol_support.tls_1_2 or protocol_support.tls_1_3 is true.
/endpoints/*/certificate/chain_length: Counts the certificates the endpoint sends in the modern handshake.
/endpoints/*/certificate/expires_in_days: Subtracts the scan time from the certificate's not_after and counts the whole days.
/endpoints/*/certificate/hostname_valid: Checks the configured host against the certificate's subject alternative names.
/endpoints/*/certificate/signature_algor: Takes the name of the leaf certificate's signature algorithm from Go's crypto/x509 package, and otherwise writes the object identifier from the certificate's signatureAlgorithm field.
/endpoints/*/certificate/trusted_chain: Verifies the chain the endpoint sends against the trusted roots, at a time inside the leaf's validity window.
/endpoints/*/port: Takes the port from the endpoint's entry in the config, and uses 443 when the entry names none.
/endpoints/*/reachable: Makes a handshake that offers TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3, and checks whether it completes.
/endpoints/*/tls/protocol_support/tls_1_: Makes a handshake that offers only TLS 1.0, and checks whether the endpoint selects TLS 1.0 in its ServerHello.
Makes a handshake that offers only TLS 1.1, and checks whether the endpoint selects TLS 1.1 in its ServerHello.
Checks whether the endpoint selects TLS 1.2 in its ServerHello, either in the modern handshake or in one that offers only TLS 1.2.
Checks whether the endpoint selects TLS 1.3 in its ServerHello, either in the modern handshake or in one that offers only TLS 1.3.
/summary/all_certificates_valid: Checks whether every endpoint's assessment.certificate_valid is true.
/summary/all_modern_protocol: Checks whether every endpoint's assessment.modern_protocol is true.
/summary/certificate_valid_count: Counts the endpoints whose assessment.certificate_valid is true.
/summary/certificate_valid_pct: Divides certificate_valid_count by total_endpoints and rounds down.
/summary/expiring_soon_count: Counts the endpoints whose assessment.expiring_soon is true.
/summary/expiring_soon_pct: Divides expiring_soon_count by total_endpoints and rounds up.
/summary/hostname_valid_count: Counts the endpoints whose assessment.hostname_valid is true.
/summary/hostname_valid_pct: Divides hostname_valid_count by total_endpoints and rounds down.
/summary/legacy_protocol_supported_count: Counts the endpoints whose assessment.legacy_protocol_supported is true.
/summary/legacy_protocol_supported_pct: Divides legacy_protocol_supported_count by total_endpoints and rounds up.
/summary/modern_protocol_count: Counts the endpoints whose assessment.modern_protocol is true.
/summary/modern_protocol_pct: Divides modern_protocol_count by total_endpoints and rounds down.
/summary/reachable_count: Counts the endpoints whose reachable is true.
/summary/reachable_pct: Divides reachable_count by total_endpoints and rounds down.
/summary/total_endpoints: Counts the endpoints in the config.
